entities.name: Xanthine-guanine phosphoribosyltransferase
observations: The 168-aa query sequence has 86.6% identity and 97.6% query coverage to reviewed UniProt Q5LRI5, annotated as xanthine-guanine phosphoribosyltransferase.
Catalyzes transfer of ribosyl-5-phosphate from PRPP to guanine and xanthine, yielding GMP or XMP and pyrophosphate; hypoxanthine is a lesser substrate. Mg2+ is annotated as cofactor.

entities.name: RHEA:25424
observations: Rhea reaction given in reverse: GMP + diphosphate = guanine + 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate (PRPP). Forward synthesis is guanine + PRPP → GMP + diphosphate.

entities.name: RHEA:10800
observations: Rhea reaction given in reverse: XMP + diphosphate = xanthine + 5-phospho-alpha-D-ribose 1-diphosphate (PRPP). Forward synthesis is xanthine + PRPP → XMP + diphosphate.
